tagline: Redesign the job before deploying the agent.
problem: AI agents are entering workflows faster than roles, decision rights and accountability are being redesigned.
Employees often experience adoption as a threat to job security, professional identity, control and fairness.
Tool training alone does not resolve the question: what does the human own when the agent can act?
solution: Create an explicit Human Owner role around every consequential agent workflow.
Give people five decision rights: direct, challenge, decide, escalate and improve.
Use GROW coaching to co-create the redesigned role instead of imposing it.
Rehearse difficult conversations safely in a six-scenario coaching simulator.
market: More than 12,000 agents were created by Singapore public healthcare professionals after AgentSea launched in late May 2026.
WEF projects 170 million jobs created and 92 million displaced by 2030, a net gain of 78 million.
86% of surveyed employers expect AI to transform their business; 77% plan to upskill workers for AI.
The opportunity is to make agent direction, review and governance part of everyday work.
product: Six fictional scenarios covering fear, anger, anxiety, scepticism, accountability and ethical purpose.
No-key demo mode for reliable workshops, plus optional AI-powered conversations.
GROW-based feedback on empathy, role clarity, decision rights and next-step experiments.
Responsive browser experience accessed directly from the presentation QR code.
traction: Tertiary already uses agents inside website and software delivery workflows.
The same human-owner pattern is used when helping clients adopt agents in software work.
The simulator is live on GitHub Pages with six complete coaching scenarios.
The Sarah case demonstrates a concrete shift from threatened doer to AI-augmented marketing lead.
business_model: Start with one role and one bounded agent workflow.
Map the work, name the accountable human owner and coach the transition.
Run a safe two-week experiment with explicit stop and escalation rules.
Measure cycle time, quality, exception handling, ownership clarity and staff confidence.

our_advantages: Work redesign, not tool training alone
Explicit decision rights and accountable ownership
Practical two-week pilot instead of a large transformation programme

team: Dr Alfred Ang: practitioner lead for AI-agent-enabled work and software workflows.
Tertiary Infotech Academy Pte Ltd: technical training, workplace learning and implementation practice.
financials: The ask: pilot one role for two weeks.
Map what the agent should do and must never do.
Name who reviews, approves, escalates and stops the workflow.
Coach one person and use evidence to decide what scales next.
